repo_main_issue_parallels.title: Graph memory, live failover, LLM plugin scaffold, and Docker packaging fix
repo_main_issue_parallels.parallel: Transforms a mobile-first control plane into a platform runtime: graph memory, plugin execution, remote storage, failover, Docker packaging, and honest live-verification boundaries.

repo_main_issue_parallels.title: Add ghm-core onboard-iphone: consent-gated LAN start for iPhone connect
repo_main_issue_parallels.parallel: Matches the local root-system requirement for iPhone operation: LAN-bound gateway, owner token, consent gate, no public tunnel, healthchecked startup.

repo_main_issue_parallels.title: Automated review rate limit reached
repo_main_issue_parallels.parallel: External review capacity is a dependency and must be modeled as a non-critical advisory channel, not as a blocking runtime component.

operating_layers.role: Creates required dirs, channels, datasets, anchors, live-sets, and validation state.

all_in_one_interpretation.target: mobile-first local root-system with repo_main-derived gateway, memory, plugin, failover, onboarding, mirror, and validation semantics
all_in_one_interpretation.primary_decision: Use local_usr/sys as the executable root-system now; import repo_main concepts as contracts until the full Rust gateway checkout is present locally.

runtime_contract.auth: owner/admin token required for state-changing or private routes
runtime_contract.network: localhost/LAN only by default; no public tunnel assumed
runtime_contract.storage: local first; remote storage only when explicitly configured
runtime_contract.plugins: fixed manifest commands only; request data never builds argv
runtime_contract.llm: disabled unless explicit provider URL/key/model are set
runtime_contract.review_bots: advisory only; rate limits never block local validation
